# netcup_user (Data Source)

The netcup SCP user of the refresh token (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_user" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_ip_login_restrictions` (String) The `apiIpLoginRestrictions` setting of the user.
- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `language` (String) Language.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `passwordless_mode` (Boolean) The `passwordlessMode` setting of the user. netcup does not document its effect.
- `show_nickname` (Boolean) Whether the SCP shows nicknames in preference to server names.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone.
- `username` (String) User name.
